title: Greedy Byte-Pair Encoding Achieves at Least 0.361 of the Optimal Compression
abstract: arXiv:2611.08671v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) builds a tokeniser by repeatedly merging a most frequent adjacent pair of symbols; its utility is the total reduction in string length achieved by $k$ merges. It was known that this greedy rule achieves at least a third of the optimal reduction. We prove that it always achieves at least 0.361 of the optimal reduction in string length, for every string, every budget and every tie-breaking rule; this is the first improvement of the bound one third. We also explain why one third was a barrier: the pair-packing relaxation behind it is tight, so a better bound must use more of the optimum's structure. When greedy destroys three of the optimum's merge points at once, one of them can usually be moved next door, because all copies of a rule of the optimum look alike; the remaining cases are paid for later. Along the way we determine the worst-case ratio for two merges exactly, bound it for three, and isolate a single i

translated_title: 贪心字节对编码至少能达到最优压缩的 0.361 倍
translated_abstract: 字节对编码（BPE）通过反复合并出现频率最高的一对相邻符号来构建分词器；其效用是 k 次合并所实现的总字符串长度缩减量。此前已知这一贪心规则至少能达到最优缩减量的三分之一。我们证明，对于任意字符串、任意预算以及任意平局打破规则，贪心规则总能达到最优字符串长度缩减量的至少 0.361 倍；这是对三分之一这一界的首次改进。我们还解释了为什么三分之一曾是一个屏障：其背后的配对打包松弛是紧的，因此更好的界必须利用最优解的更多结构。当贪心算法一次性破坏最优解的三个合并点时，其中一个通常可以被移到隔壁，因为最优解中同一条规则的所有副本看起来是相同的；其余情况则会在之后得到补偿。在此过程中，我们精确确定了两次合并情形的最坏情况比率，为三次合并情形给出了界，并分离出单个……
tldr: 本文证明贪心字节对编码在任意字符串、预算和平局打破规则下，至少能达到最优压缩缩减量的 0.361 倍，实现了对先前三分之一下界的首次改进。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that greedy Byte-Pair Encoding achieves at least 0.361 of the optimal compression reduction for every string, budget, and tie-breaking rule, marking the first improvement over the previously known one-third bound.
